One clean, exactly when you need it

Not every home needs a cleaner every week. Sometimes you just need one really good clean: the in-laws are coming, you're hosting a birthday, the house got away from you during a busy month, or you'd like to try us before committing to anything. Our one time house cleaning across Dallas–Fort Worth is exactly that. Book it once, with no contract and no follow-up schedule.

We're a locally owned Richardson company, open seven days a week, and we clean homes all over Dallas–Fort Worth.

"Salt of the Earth Cleaning Co. and Lindsey were absolutely incredible. The cleaning was beyond my expectations." — T. Rasmussen

Pick the right one-time clean

Standard cleaning: the essentials in every room. Best if your home is in decent shape and just needs a refresh.

Deep cleaning: baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, inside the oven and fridge and the build-up in bathrooms. Best if it's been a few months, or you want the house at its absolute best.

Move-in / move-out cleaning: an empty-home clean for moving day.

Not sure which to choose? Pick your home's condition in the instant quote, or call and we'll help you decide.

Before and after party cleaning

Hosting is more fun when you aren't scrubbing the guest bathroom an hour before the doorbell rings. Book a clean a day or two before your event, so the kitchen, bathrooms and floors are guest-ready. Then book another for after, and let us handle the sticky counters, the floors and the bathroom that saw a lot of visitors.

Popular occasions:

  • Birthday parties and graduation get-togethers
  • Game-day gatherings and watch parties
  • Showers, open houses and family reunions

Tell us about the event in your booking notes, including any rooms you'd like us to focus on.

Holiday cleaning

Thanksgiving, the winter holidays and visits from out-of-town family all mean more people in your home and more pressure to have it looking its best. A deep clean before the guests arrive covers the baseboards, fans and guest bathrooms; a standard clean afterward puts the house back together.

Book as early as you can for holiday dates. Need something sooner? Call and ask about this-week availability.

What every one-time clean includes

  • Kitchen counters, backsplash, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors and microwave
  • Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, sinks, mirrors and fixtures cleaned and sanitized
  • Dusting throughout reachable surfaces
  • Floors vacuumed and mopped
  • Trash emptied and beds made
  • Add-ons: inside the oven, inside the refrigerator, inside cabinets, interior windows, laundry

Got pets? Book with confidence
